parameters.query: SELECT p.id AS "prospectId", p.created_at AS "createdAt", p.current_step_id AS "currentStepId", p.halted, p.status, (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object('id', s.id, 'stepOrder', s.step_order, 'name', s.name, 'actionType', s.action_type, 'delayValue', s.delay_value, 'delayUnit', s.delay_unit) ORDER BY s.step_order), '[]'::json) FROM sequence_steps s WHERE s.campaign_id = p.campaign_id AND s.enabled = true) AS steps, (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object('stepId', e.step_id, 'eventType', e.event_type, 'occurredAt', e.occurred_at, 'payload', e.payload) ORDER BY e.occurred_at), '[]'::json) FROM events e WHERE e.prospect_id = p.id) AS events FROM prospects p WHERE p.id = $1::int
